This season I received fertilizer coupons through the FISP program, so I will put NPK and urea on my maize plot to help it grow strong. I also got hybrid seed through the program, which I trust more than the local seed I used to keep. We do not have irrigation here and I cannot afford chemicals for pests, so I will depend on the rains and my family's hard work, though I may hire a few days of labor when the weeds get thick.
